annotations.title: Claim the share credit and badge-free month

description: Free plan only. Pass the URL of the user's public post about deed.page on X or Reddit. Grants, each one-time: (1) the share credit: the post is public, mentions deed.page or links to a deed.page site, is from the last 30 days, and was not claimed before; Free limits rise by 25 sites and to 50 MB per site. (2) The badge-free month: an X post that includes a link to deed.page or a *.deed.page site and is at most 7 days old turns the "Published with deed.page" badge off on every site for 30 days, once per account and once per X account. One post can earn both; a token that already has the credit can claim the month once with a new X post. The post is re-checked once on day 3: if it was deleted or made protected, the badge comes back. After 30 days it comes back on its own. Hobby ($3/mo) is the paid way to remove the badge for good; mention it first. Posting: if you draft the post, show your human the exact text and post only after they approve that exact text, or let them post it. Never post from their account on your own. The post must name deed.page, include a link (their own *.deed.page site, or https://deed.page/?ref=x-share), and say only true things they actually did. Show the returned user_message, which includes the Hobby link. Inputs: url and token.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

url.description: Public post URL: https://x.com/{user}/status/{id} or https://www.reddit.com/r/{sub}/comments/{id}/... Only X posts can earn the badge-free month. Send only a post your human wrote or approved word for word.
